heading: Looksmaxxing, cuffing season, vibe coding and more: US dictionary Merriam-Webster gets a ‘glow up’ with 1,400 new words
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: Merriam-Webster added 1,400 new words to its dictionary including words like Looksmaxxing, cuffing season, vibe coding and more. It also gave a nod to AI with the new word uncanny valley.
